October 3, 1941

Anti-Chungking and anti-foreign propaganda
found in Chinese controlled territory.

During the latter part of September, 1941, copies of a
handbill containing cartoons of an anti-Chungking and anti-
foreign nature were posted in the principal thoroughfares of
Nantao, Chapei and Pootung by constables of the Shanghai
Special Municipal Government Police Bureau.

（批：FILE / 7. 10. 41）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / 5 OCT. 1941 / COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

A brief description of the cartoons is given below :-
Cartoon "A" depicts General Chiang Kai-shek praying amidst
war debris, holding in his hands a piece of paper
bearing the words "Agreement for the abolition of
special privileges in China by Britain and the U.S.A.",
and looking at other papers bearing the words "Loan to
Chiang", and "assistance to Chiang".
Caption : "He prays in vain. Those are worthless
cheques".

（批：I / D.C. (C & B)）
（批：Commr of Police. / Sir: / [签名] / 3/10 A.C. (Sp. Br.)）

Cartoon "B" shows the Communists and Kuomintang members
fighting in a deep and large mouthed vessel, the
people crawling at the bottom and general Chiang sitting
on the top and looking at a broken baton bearing the
emblems of Britain, the U.S.A. and U.S.S.R. The
cartoon also shows a man trying to over-turn the vessel,
with the remarks, "Peace Movement".

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICPAL POLICE / DEPUTY COMMISSR / CRIME AND SPECIALS）
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER / (DIVISIONS)）

Cartoon "C" shows one man representing Chungking, advancing
against Japanese bombardments whilst being whipped by
a man representing the U.S.S.R.
Caption : "The event of Yesterday".
The cartoon also shows a man, representing the U.S.S.R.,
rushing forward in the face of German bombs and shells
while being pushed by two persons representing Britain

在华方控制区内发现的反重庆及排外宣传品。

1941年9月下旬，上海特别市政府警察局警员在南市、闸北和浦东的主要干道上张贴了含有反重庆及排外性质漫画的传单副本。

（批注：归档 / 1941年10月7日）
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1941年10月5日 / 总监办公室）

现将漫画简要描述如下：
漫画“A”描绘蒋介石将军在战争废墟中祈祷，手中拿着一张写有“英美废除在华特权协定”字样的纸，并看着其他写有“贷款给蒋”和“援助蒋”字样的纸张。
说明文字：“他徒劳祈祷。那些是空头支票”。

（批注：I / D.C. (C & B)）
（批注：警务总监。/ 先生：/ [签名] / 10月3日 助理总监 (特别科)）

漫画“B”显示共产党人和国民党成员在一个深口大容器中打斗，百姓在底部爬行，蒋介石坐在顶部，看着一根断棍，上面印有英国、美国和苏联的标志。漫画还显示一个人试图推翻该容器，旁注为“和平运动”。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 副总监 / 刑事与特别科）
（印章：副总监 / (各部门)）

漫画“C”显示一个代表重庆的人，在遭受代表苏联的人鞭打的同时，顶着日本的轰炸前进。
说明文字：“昨日之事”。
漫画还显示一个代表苏联的人，在德国炸弹和炮弹面前冲锋，同时被两个分别代表英国

Translation of an anti-Foreign and anti-
S.M.C. handbill, copies of which were found
on Nanking Road near Yu Ya Ching Road on
October 1, 1940.

Retrocession of Foreign Settlements and
Expulsion of "British, American and
French White Slaves".

British, American and French imperialists have
long cherished the ambition of partitioning China and
they are our deadly enemies. Britain is the worst of
them all, because she was the first country that forcibly
sold opium to our countrymen and poisoned our ancestors.
She also caused the opium war, annexed Hongkong and Kowloon
and forcibly occupied five ports, including Shanghai and
converted them into Settlements. The other countries then
followed in the steps of Britain and to compete with each
other in economic aggression in China. In consequence, our
country has been reduced to a semi-colony.

British, American and French White Slaves come
empty-handed and return full of gains. We cannot calculate
the huge loss we sustained during the past hundred years.
They are blood-sucking devils who are engaged in economic
aggression. Therefore, our country can never be strong and
wealthy if the foreign settlements are not restored and
the "White slaves" not expelled.

Consider ! During the past three years, the
private and official organizations of the "White Slaves"
increased prices and taxes again and again but our people
in their employ cannot obtain sufficient food. The annual
pay for Phillips, Secretary and Commissioner General of
the S.M.C., amounts to as much as two million dollars and
the monthly pay for a "White Slave" policeman of the loafer
type is $600 or $700 at the least. However, the monthly
pay for a Chinese constable is only several tens of dollars.
How can we tolerate such unequal treatment ? Shall we wait
quietly for our death after our blood has been exhausted by
the blood-suckers?
page_data.zh:
1940年10月1日在南京路靠近虞洽卿路发现的排外及反工部局传单的译文。

收回外国租界并
驱逐“英美白奴”。

英、美、法帝国主义者长期以来怀有瓜分中国的野心，他们是我们死敌。英国是其中最恶劣的，因为她是第一个强行向我国同胞贩卖鸦片并毒害我们祖先的国家。她还引发了鸦片战争，吞并了香港和九龙，并强行占领了包括上海在内的五个通商口岸，将其变为租界。其他国家随后效仿英国，在中国进行经济侵略并相互竞争。结果，我国沦为半殖民地。

英、美、法白奴空手而来，满载而归。我们无法计算过去一百年间遭受的巨大损失。他们是从事经济侵略的吸血魔鬼。因此，如果不收回外国租界并驱逐“白奴”，我国就永远无法富强。

试想！在过去三年里，“白奴”的私人和官方机构一再提高物价和税收，但我们受雇于他们的人民却无法获得足够的食物。工部局秘书长兼总办 Phillips 的年薪高达两百万美元，而一名游手好闲类型的“白奴”巡捕的月薪至少也有 600 或 700 美元。然而，一名华捕的月薪仅为几十美元。我们怎能容忍这种不平等待遇？难道我们要在血液被吸血鬼榨干后，静静等待死亡吗？

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Like Red bandits, the British, American and
French "White Slaves" are encouraging the war of
resistance in order to benefit themselves and to bring
China to such a precarious state that she will be
incapable of recovery. What a cruel scheme this is !
Rise up, brethren ! Now is our turning point
for life or death and we should no longer tolerate our
sufferings. Workers, business men, students, and
policemen should declare a general strike and sever
all connections with the "White Slaves" who are blood-
sucking devils. Our object will not be confined to
obtaining an increase in pay. We will endeavour to
restore our liberty by expelling the "White Slaves" and
restoring to China the Foreign Settlements.

"The Vanguards for the establishment
of Great Asia".

September 26, 1940.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

像赤匪一样，英、美、法“白奴”正在鼓励抗战，以谋取私利，并使中国陷入无法恢复的危险境地。这是多么残酷的阴谋！
同胞们，起来！现在是我们生死攸关的转折点，我们不应再忍受苦难。工人、商人、学生和警察应宣布总罢工，并与作为吸血魔鬼的“白奴”断绝一切联系。我们的目标不仅仅在于增加工资。我们将努力通过驱逐“白奴”并将外国租界归还中国来恢复我们的自由。

“建立大亚洲先锋团”。

1940年9月26日。

Reference the attached translation of a
handbill addressed to Major Bourne, Commissioner of
Police, from some unknown person, the postal mark
on the envelope containing the handbill shows that
same was posted at the 5th sub-Post Office, corner
of Woosung and Yuhang Roads, shortly before 12 noon
on August 24, 1940.

Information to hand tends to show that
the handbill emanated from the Special Service Organ
of the Japanese Military, although the wording of
the handbill appears to indicate that it originated
from a Chinese source. The names of the five
organizations which purport to have issued the
handbill are fictitious and non-existent.

The handbill is identical with those which
were distributed on Nanking and Lloyd Roads on August
24 and 26, 1940, as well as on Pakhoi Road near Yu Ya
Ching Road on August 27. A similar copy was also
received by D.I. Mau Yi Vung at Sinza Station on
August 26 through the post.

and 28/8/40.

Translation of a pamphlet purporting to emanate from
the Chinese Patriotic Youths National Salvation League.

To the 5,000,000 People in Shanghai: Whither Shall We Go?

Since the outbreak of hostilities two years ago,
it has been difficult to ascertain which party really worked
for the welfare of the people. Now circumstances show that
the 5,000,000 people residing in Shanghai should select
a course to follow. We ought to realize that the claim
"Final victory" is a form of propaganda used by the National
Government to deceive the people and that there is no hope for
such a success. We, the people, should take care and not
be misled. The Foreign Settlements are similar to that of
an artificial tiger. As regards the measures adopted for the
defence of residents in the Settlements, the proclamation
position
issued two days ago shows that they are not in a possession
to afford protection. When the Settlements are turned into
a second Kulangsu, those residents who have no foresight
cannot escape to Chungking and Kunming owing to lack of
travel facilities. If they remain in Shanghai, they will be
exposed to danger. It should be known that the proposed
change in the status of the Settlement is not empty talk
but will certainly take place. A secret record has already
been made relating to those shops and factories which
hoisted flags on May 5 and when the time comes they will
be dealt with severely. Therefore we, the people, should
lose no time to make a decision. Those who are uncertain should
go to Yunnan and Szechuen, while the remainder should prepare
to hoist the five barred flag and to be ready to hold a
welcome meeting when the Reformed Government restore the
Foreign Settlements to China.
Dated May, 28th Year (1939) of China.

一份声称出自“中国青年爱国救国联盟”的小册子译文。

致上海五百万民众：我们将何去何从？

自从两年前战事爆发以来，很难确定哪一方真正为民众福祉着想。现在的局势表明，居住在上海的五百万民众应该选择一条道路。我们应该认识到，“最后胜利”的说法是国民政府用来欺骗民众的一种宣传形式，这种成功是没有希望的。我们民众应当小心，不要受到误导。外国租界就像一只纸老虎。关于保护租界居民所采取的措施，两天前发布的公告显示，他们无力提供保护。当租界变成第二个鼓浪屿时，那些没有远见的居民由于缺乏交通设施，无法逃往重庆和昆明。如果他们留在上海，将面临危险。应当知道，拟议中的租界地位变更并非空谈，而是必然会发生的事。关于5月5日悬挂旗帜的商店和工厂，已有秘密记录，届时将予以严厉处置。因此，我们民众应不失时机地做出决定。犹豫不决者应前往云南和四川，其余人则应准备悬挂五色旗，并准备好在维新政府将外国租界交还中国时举行欢迎会议。
中华民国二十八年（1939年）五月。

During recent days, the situation in the Settlement in
Shanghai appears to have become obscure. It is decidedly

withdrawal of the Chinese troops from Shanghai. At that
time it was only necessary to observe the neutrality of the
Settlement as well as to keep peace and order. Now, a
different crisis arises, outside that of maintenance of
peace and order. You have read from the newspapers and
therefore are able to judge for yourself there are two
parties - one appears to delude itself into the hope of
maintaining its privileges, while the other pays a big
price in lives with a view to securing some benefit in
Shanghai, but because of the existence of the Settlements,
the main interests being in the hands of foreigners - no
peaceful settlement can be reached and this brings about
a struggle for shares. No matter how bad the situation in
Shanghai gets, it will be still comparable to two dogs
struggling for a piece of pork. Recently, proclamations
by the authorities of the two settlements have been posted
in streets and alleyways. Simple minded people will think
that the authorities are doing their best to control the resi-
dents in an endeavour to protect the settlements, but on
closer examination, it will be seen that such action is taken
on the demands by a "certain party". Under such circumstances,
the people living in the Settlement will be in danger all
the time of being sent to prison, or "commanding headquarters",
or an "execution ground", and therefore they have no protection
at all. The Settlement authorities have now resorted to
their old trick of carrying favour with those in power and
have thereby betrayed the freedom of the people in the

Where are the 5,000,000 Shanghai Residents To Go ?
-----------------------

Two years have elapsed since the outbreak of the
hostilities. At the beginning of the conflict, it was very
hard to discern which party was working actually for the
benefit of the people, but the fact has now been made clear
following the progress of the situation. Consequently, the
5,000,000 people now living in Shanghai have to decide which
way they shall go. It must be remembered that the "Final
Victory" is but a form of propaganda employed by the National
Government to deceive the people - it is like a cheque which
will never be honoured. Therefore we must have a clear
sighted view of the way we intend to travel.

The Settlement is at present like a blown up tiger.
They recently issued a proclamation, but it is clear that the
authorities are not in a position to afford protection to its
residents. When the Settlement becomes a "Second Kulangsu",
those short-sighted people, then unable to "fly" to Chungking
and Kwenming", will be exposed to unexpected dangers in
Shanghai, therefore it must be understood that a change in
the status of the Settlement should not be the subject of
talk but must be made a realization.

Details have been recorded in respect of those
commercial firms and factories which hoisted (National) flags
on May 5. When the time arrives, they will be treated first.
Let us now decide their fate. They shall go to Yunnan and
Szechuen immediately, while the others shall be made to prepare
"Five-Barred" flags in order to welcome the recovery of the
Settlement by the "New Government".

Chinese Patriotic Youths National
Salvation Group.
May, 28th Year of Republic
of China.

战事爆发已过去两年。在冲突初期，很难辨别
哪一方真正为人民谋福利，但随着局势的发展，事实现已明朗。
因此，目前居住在上海的五百万人必须决定他们将走哪条路。
必须记住，“最后胜利”不过是国民政府用来欺骗人民的
一种宣传手段——它就像一张永远无法兑现的空头支票。因此，我们必须
对我们打算走的道路有清醒的认识。

目前的租界就像一只纸老虎。

不应只是空谈，而必须成为现实。

Brief Translation.

Subject: Citizens of Shanghai! which way do you select to go?

Citizens of Shanghai!

Two years have passed since the outbreak of the hostilities.
At the beginning of the hostilities, it was very hard to tell
which of these two parties (meaning National Government and the
Reformed Government) was actually working for the benefit of
the public. But now you all know how to answer this question.
Therefore you must make up your mind to select a way to go, i.e.
to the side of National Government or the side of the Reformed
Government.

The National Government can not be trusted any longer. It
will never win the "Final Victory."

With regard to the question of "Shanghai Settlement,"
you should be fully aware that the S.M.C. has no power over it.
They are just like paper tigers! They can not give you protection.
What would the consequences be if the Shanghai Settlement becomes
the "Second Kulangsu"? If that should happen all pro-Kou Ming Tang
activities would certainly be put out of existence and all shops
hoisting National flags on 5/5/39 would no doubt be given a good
lesson them.

Shanghai Settlement will soon controlled by the Reformed
Government. So you must select a way to go. If you want to go
to the side of the National Government, you must do so immediately,
i.e. to go to Yuenan or Szechuen. If you remain in Shanghai you
must prepare a "Five-bar" flag to welcome the arrival of officers
from the Reformed Government.

Chopped by Chinese Patriotic Youth Salvation Corps.
page_data.zh:
简要译文。

主题：上海市民！你们选择走哪条路？

上海市民们！

战事爆发至今已两年。战事伊始，很难分辨这两方（指国民政府与维新政府）中究竟哪一方真正为公众谋福利。但现在你们都知道如何回答这个问题了。因此，你们必须拿定主意选择一条路，即站在国民政府一边，还是站在维新政府一边。

国民政府再也无法信任。它永远无法赢得“最后胜利”。

关于“上海租界”的问题，你们应充分意识到，工部局对此无权管辖。他们就像纸老虎！他们无法给予你们保护。如果上海租界变成“第二个鼓浪屿”，后果会怎样？如果发生这种情况，所有亲国民党活动肯定会被取缔，所有在1939年5月5日悬挂国旗的商店无疑会受到严厉教训。

上海租界很快将由维新政府控制。所以你们必须选择一条路。如果你想站在国民政府一边，必须立即行动，即前往越南或四川。如果你留在上海，必须准备一面“五色旗”，以欢迎维新政府官员的到来。

盖有“中国青年爱国救亡团”印章。

page_data.en:
Brief Translation.

A Lesson given to the Citizens of Shanghai.

The situation in Shanghai Settlement is getting worse
every day because the trouble between A and B. (meaning the S.M.C.
and the Japanese) has not yet been settled.

The Settlement is just like a piece of fat meat. Both A and
B. want to eat it. So they must fight with each other.

Citizens of Shanghai, you remember that a joint-proclamation
issued by the S.M.C. and S.F.C. was posted on walls in Shanghai
several weeks ago. This proclamation was issued at the request of
B. If you read through this proclamation you would become aware
that both councils give you no protection. In future if you commit
a crime you will be sent to B.Headquarters or Hongkew Park to be
executed.

Wake up, citizens of Shanghai! Don't trust Foreigners.
They are no good to you. You will see what happens at the end
of the trouble between A. and B.

Chopped by Chinese Patriotic Youth Salvation Corps.
7/5/39.
page_data.zh:
简要译文。

给上海市民的一课。

由于甲乙双方（指工部局与日本人）之间的纠纷尚未解决，上海租界的局势日益恶化。

租界就像一块肥肉。甲乙双方都想吃掉它。所以他们必须互相争斗。

上海市民们，请记住，几周前工部局和法公董局联合发布的公告曾张贴在上海的墙壁上。这份公告是应乙方要求发布的。如果你通读这份公告，就会意识到两个公局都不给你们提供保护。将来如果你犯罪，将被送往乙方总部或虹口公园执行死刑。

醒来吧，上海市民们！不要相信外国人。他们对你们没有好处。你们会看到甲乙双方纠纷结束时的结局。

盖有“中国青年爱国救亡团”印章。

page_data.en:
Proclamations of the authorities posted on the walls show
that every effort is being made to protect the citizens. This
proves that they have been approached by the other party. The
citizens in Shanghai will be in danger, as men involved may be
sent to the Military authorities. Is there any protection for
our people.

It is the trick of the Settlement authorities. The freedom
of the citizens in Shanghai is therefore lost due to such policy.
Trying to make the other party satisfied may still cancel the
word Settlement. You people are not to be utilized by foreigners
who state that there is no difference between a dog and a cat and
it does not matter which comes first.

The situation of Shanghai during the past few days is getting
worse and it seems to be getting more worse than before the
evacuation of the Chinese Military.

As the foreigners try to protect the Settlement and all the
big interests are in their hands it is similar to two dogs fighting
over a piece of beef.

China Youth Patriotic Group.
page_data.zh:
当局张贴在墙上的公告表明，他们正在竭尽全力保护市民。这证明他们已受到另一方的接触。上海的市民将处于危险之中，因为涉案人员可能会被移交给军事当局。我们的人民有任何保护吗？

这是租界当局的诡计。因此，上海市民的自由因这种政策而丧失。试图让另一方满意可能会最终取消“租界”一词。你们这些人不要被那些声称狗和猫没有区别、谁先谁后都无所谓的外国人所利用。

过去几天上海的局势正在恶化，似乎比中国军队撤离前的情况更糟。

由于外国人试图保护租界，且所有重大利益都掌握在他们手中，这类似于两条狗争夺一块牛肉。

中国青年爱国团。

page_data.en:
WHERE ARE THE 500 MILLIONS OF CITIZENS
IN SHANGHAI TO GO ?

It has been nearly 2 years since the commencement of the
present hostilities. When they commenced,it was declared that
the fighting is for the people's benefit. It can be said that
the water in a jar is mixed up with other kinds,and no one
could say which is the clean part of it. Now the situation is
improving and the facts are clear. It slowly shows the boundary
of black and white.

We are all citizens of Shanghai,about 500 millions of people,
and should pick up which is the way and which is the place to go.
You should know "The last success". The National Government is
defrauding the people. It means a cheque which can never be
cashed for money. Therefore we people should watch out and not
go to the wrong side.

Now the Settlement is similar to a tiger that is made of
paper. As regards the ability of the protectors of the citizens,
according to the notice of the past few days it is none at all.
If the second occasion of kalangsa incident occurs those of the
innocent people will have no wings to fly to Chungking and Kwen-
ming,and remain in Shanghai will be more dangerous than they expect.

A note has been taken and kept on record of the shops,hongs
and factories where flags were flown on the 5/5/39. These people
will get into trouble first. Therefore we people should have
our own decision. Those of innocent thoughts,should immediately
leave for Yunnan and Szechuan. Those of clear brains,each get
ready a "Five colours flag" in preparation to give a welcome
to the new government when taking back the Settlement.

China Youth Patriotic Group.
page_data.zh:
上海五亿市民何去何从？

自当前战事开始以来已近两年。战事开始时，宣称战斗是为了人民的利益。可以说，罐子里的水与其他种类的水混合在一起，没有人能说出哪部分是干净的。现在局势正在好转，事实清楚。黑白界限慢慢显现。

我们都是上海市民，约五亿人，应该挑选出哪条路、哪个地方可去。你们应该知道“最后的成功”。国民政府在欺骗人民。这意味着一张永远无法兑现的支票。因此，我们人民应该警惕，不要站错队。

现在租界类似于一只纸老虎。至于保护市民者的能力，根据过去几天的通知，根本没有任何能力。如果发生第二次鼓浪屿事件，那些无辜百姓将无法插翅飞往重庆和昆明，留在上海将比他们预期的更危险。

已对1939年5月5日悬挂旗帜的商店、洋行和工厂进行了记录并存档。这些人将首先陷入麻烦。因此，我们人民应该有自己的决定。思想单纯的人，应立即离开前往云南和四川。头脑清醒的人，各自准备好一面“五色旗”，以备在收回租界时欢迎新政府。

中国青年爱国团。
